prompts: Single isolated two-dimensional VFX sprite for a Korean martial arts game. Single transparent hand-painted 2D action game VFX sprite. A powerful DOWNWARD cone of impact energy from a single contact point at TOP CENTER. Shaped like an inverted fan opening toward the bottom, wide horizontal crown at the top. Thick flat angular wedges of luminous warm ivory and pale gold in its center, bold cinnabar vermilion dry brush along the sides, an indigo ink shadow contour. Three large expressive torn triangular speed strokes and a few scattered gold and dark ink chips. The contact flare is a wide flat ivory flash along the upper edge, ink thrusts diagonally down to both lower corners. Strong legible arcade pixel-art silhouette at 35 pixels size, high contrast bold graphic compact second animation keyframe of Korean wuxia rhythm-game strike. Actual isolated visual effect, no training gear, hands, text, objects, backdrop, full scene, gradient glow, smoke or ground shadows.
